verdict.rationale: The client lets analysts submit a task (e.g., JobNames.LITERATURE) that runs autonomously and can take a long time, matching 'unattended long research job' (futurehouse-docs-4, futurehouse-docs-5, futurehouse-docs-13). However, the documented API is synchronous/polling (`run_tasks_until_done`), and there is no evidence of an async job ID, webhook, email, or push notification mechanism that alerts the analyst when the job finishes.  missing for 10: explicit async/notification API (webhooks, email alerts, or job-status callbacks), independent confirmation of unattended background execution beyond blocking client call.
